title: Link for Technical Bid Opening via Web Conferencing Facility against Tender No. IPC/5519/2020-21
bodyHtml:
Technical Bid Opening against Tender No. IPC/5519/2020-21 for procurement of Karl Fischer Titrator Equipment, is schedule to take place via Web Conferencing Facility on 20th October 2020 (Tuesday) 15:00 hrs.

Please join my meeting from your computer, tablet or smartphone.
https://global.gotomeeting.com/join/475581957 (opens in a new tab)

Access Code: 475-581-957
Note:
1. To join meeting via internet browser on computer, click the link provided to download extension and click the downloaded extension to start meeting.
2. To join meeting via smartphone/tablet, download GoToMeeting App from Android Playstore/Apple App Store and click the link provided to start meeting.
3. Ensure uninterrupted Internet connection and good camera with mic to join GoToMeeting from your computer, tablet or smartphone.
4. For any query/assistance to join GoTo Meeting, kindly contact our IT Associate(9718250844)
